youtube.title: 為什麼方框吹出來的泡泡還是圓的？透明水變彩虹的真相｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
把鐵絲彎成方框沾泡泡水，吹出來的泡泡竟然還是圓的！而且透明無色的泡泡水，吹出來不只一直轉出彩虹，最後頭頂一變黑就破了！
一次看懂泡泡皮背後的雙重物理秘密：表面張力與方盒子比圓球多約兩成面積、加肥皂竟是讓表面張力降到清水三分之一、封在罐子裡撐三個月不破的長壽泡泡、小泡泡氣壓更高把大泡泡推進去與 120 度三牆規則、兩道反射光波干涉變彩虹、頂上黑皮薄到一毫米的四萬分之一、歪頭看色跳的觀看角度，以及雨後路面油漬的同一招！

📚 參考研究與官方出處：
- Exploratorium (Ron Hipschman): The Shape of Bubbles / Sticky Water / When Bubble Meets Bubble / Bubble Colors / Soap / Formulae：https://annex.exploratorium.edu/ronh/bubbles/shape_of_bubbles.html
- Exploratorium Science Explorer: See Colors in Bubbles：https://annex.exploratorium.edu/science-explorer/bub_dome.html
- Virginia Tech: Bubble Physics (Properties & Basic Information)：https://www1.phys.vt.edu/bubble/properties-of-bubbles.html
- Wolfram MathWorld: Double Bubble：https://mathworld.wolfram.com/DoubleBubble.html
- HyperPhysics: Soap Film Interference：https://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/phyopt/soapfilm.html
- CU Boulder Physics Labs: Interference in a Soap Film：https://physicslabs.colorado.edu/demos/optics/interference/thin-films/interference-in-a-soap-film/

scenes.chapter: 方框吹出圓泡泡，頭頂變黑就快破？

data.prompt: Medium shot in a sunlit backyard courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding up a bent square metal wire bubble wand in one five-fingered hand while staring wide-eyed at a shimmering round rainbow soap bubble floating beside her.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 所長！我用方框沾透明水吹泡泡，吹出來竟是彩虹圓球，頭頂一變黑還馬上要破，這層泡泡皮怎麼在作怪？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio tabletop comparison: a translucent shimmering cube-shaped soap frame on left contrasted with a compact gleaming perfectly round rainbow soap bubble hovering effortlessly on right, catching crisp golden sunbeams.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 全怪這層薄到看不出厚度的皮！它天生超省料，死不肯維持方形；頭頂變黑時，皮更只剩一毫米的四萬分之一！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden sill: two merged iridescent soap bubbles—a tiny tense bubble bulging dramatically inward into a much larger bubble—resting right beside a sealed clear glass jar sheltering a luminous bubble inside.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更怪的是，小泡泡撞大泡泡竟是小的把大的推進去；甚至有人把泡泡封進罐子，一口氣撐了三個月！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling warmly behind her oak desk holding a clean clear bottle of bubble water and a small square wire wand.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 今天我們就來聊聊，這層薄薄的泡泡皮怎麼在作怪——先沾一下你手上的方框，看它怎麼偷偷作弊！

scenes.chapter: 泡泡皮一直想縮小！加肥皂竟然不是為了拉更緊？

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, dipping her square wire wand into a clear bottle and peering eagerly at the shiny flat translucent film stretched across the square.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 你看，沾一下泡泡水，方框裡先是一片平平的皮！框明明是方的，一吹出去怎麼馬上縮成圓的？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit macro editorial metaphor: a gleaming ultra-thin clear water layer tucked neatly like a luminous translucent sandwich filling between two delicate shimmering golden-white soap layers.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這片皮其實是「水三明治」：薄薄一層水夾在中間，兩面各貼一層肥皂；你一吹氣，它就被撐大包住一團空氣。

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit patio bench: a bright yellow latex balloon releasing air and shrinking beside a square wire wand where a half-blown soap bubble smoothly pulls itself back into a flat shimmering square pane.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這層皮像撐大的氣球皮，隨時想縮小！吹到一半停下來，泡泡會自己把空氣擠出、縮回框裡變回平皮。

data.prompt: Close-up sparkling sunlit soap bubble hovering over honey-oak wood, delicate translucent pearlescent tension ripples drawing smoothly inward across its taut gleaming round surface.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這種一直往內拉、想把自己縮到最小的力氣叫「表面張力」——對泡泡皮來說，能縮就縮、多一點都不肯！

data.prompt: Wide shot sunny backyard lawn: three colorful wire bubble wands—a square, a triangle, and a five-point star—each releasing a perfectly spherical iridescent soap bubble floating upward into bright blue sky.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 包一樣多空氣，方盒子比圓球多用約兩成的皮；圓球最省料，所以不管什麼形狀的框，飛出去全拉成圓的！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding up the clear bottle of bubbly water with a proud confident nod.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來是表面張力拼命往內拉！那清水吹不出泡泡、加肥皂才吹得出來，是因為肥皂把張力拉得更緊吧？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio ceramic bowl of crystal clear water: one golden drop of dish soap touching the calm water surface and sending out a soft shimmering relaxing ripple ring.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 剛好完全相反！加肥皂反而讓表面張力變小，只剩清水的三分之一左右——清水拉太用力又乾太快，一下就破！

data.prompt: Close-up warm sunlit studio shelf: a single glistening soap bubble resting peacefully atop a small glass saucer inside a tightly sealed clear glass mason jar catching golden afternoon sunlight.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 肥皂像層蓋子讓皮裡的水慢點乾！開頭說有人把泡泡封進罐子不讓它乾，竟然穩穩撐了整整三個月！

data.prompt: Close-up time-lapse style triptych inside a clear glass jar on oak wood: the same single glistening soap bubble shrinking cleanly from large to medium to tiny marble size without bursting.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 就算封罐不乾它也不會永遠不變：跟氣球放氣變鬆不同，泡泡縮再小都還在拉，空氣慢慢滲掉，沒破卻越縮越小！

scenes.chapter: 兩顆泡泡撞一起竟不破，小的還把大的推進去？

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning excitedly over two floating iridescent bubbles drifting toward each other with wide curious eyes.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 難怪沒破也能越縮越小！那要是兩顆都這麼拚命省皮的泡泡在空中撞在一起，會當場破掉還是黏起來？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio macro: two identical-sized shimmering iridescent soap bubbles fused gracefully into a neat double bubble sharing one crisp completely flat mirror-like partition wall right down the center.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 如果兩顆一樣大，常常不會破，而是黏成一對合用中間一片平牆——照樣是為了省皮，合用一片更省料！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, cupping one big hand and one tiny hand in front of her with a puzzled grin.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 兩顆一樣大合用平牆很有道理！那一大一小黏在一起，開頭怎麼說反而是小泡泡把大泡泡推進去？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio macro: a small tight pearlescent soap bubble merged with a much larger soap bubble, the shared iridescent film wall clearly bulging smoothly inward into the larger bubble's space.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 中間的牆真的會往大泡泡凸過去！同一瓶水拉力相同，但小泡泡彎得更急，往裡面擠的力氣更集中。

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic visual contrast on daylight grey: a tight small curved soap arc glowing vivid warm amber pressing gently outward against a broad gentle large soap arc glowing calm sky blue.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 皮擠得越緊，把裡面空氣壓得越緊，所以小泡泡氣壓反而更高——每次一黏上，永遠是小的推向大的！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden tabletop comparison: three merged shimmering soap bubbles meeting cleanly at a crisp symmetric Y-junction in the center, sitting beside a charming round sponge cake sliced evenly into three equal wedges.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 如果三顆擠在一起更整齊：三片牆總會像均切圓蛋糕一樣，在中心剛好碰出一百二十度！

scenes.chapter: 泡泡水明明是透明的，彩虹顏色從哪變出來？

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding the crystal-clear bottle of colorless bubble water up to the sun with one hand while pointing at a bright rainbow bubble with the other.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 連三顆黏一起都要精準分一百二十度！可這瓶泡泡水明明全透明沒顏料，彩虹是皮拉太緊變出來的嗎？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio optical display on pale wood: a bright pure white beam of sunlight splitting cleanly into rainbow ribbons where subtracting the blue ribbon leaves a warm glowing golden-yellow pool of light.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 拉力只管形狀！透明泡泡根本沒上色，而是把混合各色光的陽光活生生「消掉」一種顏色——像拿掉藍就偏黃！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding up her wire wand against bright sunlight with wide skeptical eyes.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 等等！白光混了各種顏色我知道，可是薄薄一層透明泡泡皮，怎麼可能把其中一種顏色消掉？

data.prompt: Close-up luminous studio cutaway: a translucent glistening soap skin catching a sunlit white ray that splits into two delicate shimmering reflected gleams—one bouncing right off the outer face, the second passing through and bouncing off the inner face.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 因為泡泡皮雖薄，仍有外面跟裡面兩個面！陽光照過來各彈回一道光，裡面那道得多穿過皮、多走一點路！

data.prompt: Wide shot serene sunlit garden pond viewed from angled above: two tiny pebbles dropped together creating two expanding concentric crystal water-ripple rings that collide into taller bright crests and eerily flat smooth calm patches.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 像水波高碰高變亮、高碰低抵掉，每種色光的波長不同，兩道光一碰就有的色加強、紅光剛好抵掉就偏藍綠！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, lighting up with a sharp eureka sparkle holding up her square wire wand.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那我猜，被抵掉哪種顏色全看這層皮有多厚——厚薄一變，裡面那道多走的路跟著變，顏色就換了吧？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling intriguingly while holding up a clean square wire wand gleaming with soft shifting hues.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 猜得超準！把泡泡停在沾濕方框上、固定正前方看免得斜看改變多走的路，你剛說的頭頂變黑也能看個清楚！

scenes.chapter: 現場實驗：頭頂變黑前夕竟薄到四萬分之一毫米！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding her square wire wand very steady with a glistening soap bubble hanging quietly from it, pointing excitedly at neat horizontal rainbow bands.

lines.text: 哇！真的耶，我才剛盯著不動，泡泡身上的彩虹竟然排成一條一條橫著往下滑！

data.prompt: Close-up macro of a single iridescent soap bubble hanging calmly from a wire wand against a soft dark garden background: crisp horizontal pastel-cyan, magenta, and golden stripes slowly sliding downward as water drains toward the bottom droplet.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這正印證你剛才說的！地球把泡泡水慢慢往下拉，底下厚、頂上薄，皮越變越薄，顏色就一條一條跟著往下換。

data.prompt: Close-up dramatic macro of a hanging soap bubble against a clean dark navy shadow backdrop: bright magenta and gold bands near the middle fading upward into an eerie pitch-black crystal-clear patch right at the very top crown.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 快看頂上變黑了！外面彈回的光波會高變低翻倒、裡面那道不會；皮薄到幾乎沒多走路時，一正一反全抵掉就黑了！

data.prompt: Close-up ethereal studio scene: a glowing translucent soap bubble crown turning velvety dark right before tiny delicate sparkling mist droplets poise at its rim, zero text or numbers.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 美國舊金山的科學博物館探索館估算，這時頂上的皮只剩開頭說的一毫米的四萬分之一，隨時都可能撐不住！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, blinking in amazement as the dark-crowned bubble hangs steady for a couple extra moments on her wire wand.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 咦？我原本以為頭頂一變黑就會當場炸掉，結果它竟然還安安穩穩多撐了一下下耶！

data.prompt: Close-up studio side-by-side: a shimmering rainbow soap bubble with a velvety black crown glowing unmistakably vivid against a deep charcoal wall, contrasted against a pale washed-out sunlit sky.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 沒錯，頂上變黑就像最後倒數，有時還能穩住幾秒——而且背後背景越暗，這塊黑頂蓋跟四周彩虹就越清楚！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit macro of a floating iridescent soap bubble caught in a gentle summer breeze: luminous teal, violet, and gold color swirls marbling fluidly across its curved glistening surface.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 停在框上會排出整齊橫條，但飄在空中彩虹卻一直打轉——全因微風吹動皮裡的水流來流去，厚薄隨時在換！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the quiet sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, looking curiously at a still glass window wondering if colors stop indoors.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那如果躲進完全沒風的房間裡，沒有微風去吹動泡泡皮裡的水，顏色就會停住不動嗎？

data.prompt: Close-up tranquil sunlit indoor desk: a glistening soap bubble resting peacefully as a bright crystal dome on a wet ceramic plate while slow smooth pastel rainbow bands glide calmly downward.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 還是會動！關起窗讓泡泡停在濕盤上變半顆圓頂，少了微風打轉，水仍會默默往盤邊滑落，色帶照樣一圈圈移位！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tilting her head playfully sideways while staring in sudden surprise at the hanging soap bubble whose colors shifted instantly.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 連沒風停盤上都在變色！等等，剛這顆明明沒動，我脖子一歪顏色竟瞬間跳掉，難道一瞬間皮變薄了？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio optical comparison: a single steady soap skin seen straight-on glowing warm gold on left vs seen from a tilted side angle glowing vivid turquoise-magenta on right, zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 沒那麼巧！皮的厚薄沒變，變的是你看的角度——光斜斜穿過皮時，裡面那道光多走的路，跟直直看時不一樣長！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the sunny courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, nodding happily with wide bright eyes watching a floating bubble drift in the breeze.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 難怪剛才所長叫我固定正前方看！平常在戶外追泡泡，風又吹人又跑，厚薄跟角度一起換，彩虹才會閃得那麼花！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, eyes lighting up eagerly holding a tiny wooden ruler prop beside a shimmering bubble.

data.prompt: Close-up clean studio visual on dark slate: a long smooth wedge of iridescent soap film displaying the same rose-gold and cyan hues repeating cyclically across three distinct thickness bands, zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 量不準！皮變薄時像藍綠、洋紅、黃色會在不同厚度重複亮好幾輪，單憑眼睛分不清哪一輪，只能當線索不能當尺！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit optics lab bench: a sleek brass optical mount holding a flat glistening soap frame under one steady beam of white light with a tiny angled viewing prism, zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 除非進實驗室把光源、觀看角度跟第幾輪全都控制死，否則單靠肉眼拍張照，永遠沒辦法直接報出準確厚度。

data.prompt: Wide shot atmospheric sunlit Taiwanese asphalt street right after a summer rain shower: a gleaming wet puddle with a thin flowing iridescent oil patch shimmering with vivid magenta, gold, and cyan interference swirls.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 這種靠透明薄層讓兩道反射光互相加強或抵掉的把戲不只泡泡會——雨後馬路上那層油亮亮的彩色水漬也是同一招！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden display showing a sparkling crystal water droplet next to a shimmering iridescent thin oil ribbon glowing effortlessly with rainbow hues without any paint jars nearby.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 只要有一層薄到跟光波差不多尺度的透明薄膜，完全不需要半滴顏料，光自己就能變出整片流光七彩！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio macro: a delicate cluster of crisp dry iridescent soap bubbles sandwiched between two clear glass slides showing neat three-wall Y-intersections repeating across the whole foam, zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 更妙的是，不管是一整串肥皂泡沫還是單獨飄飛的小球，每一處牆面交叉都守著三片相交的省料規矩，同時閃出彩虹！

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright sunlit courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tilting her head with a sudden bright realization comparing her square wire wand and the iridescent colors.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 哇，連整串泡沫跟雨後油漬都藏著同樣規矩！所以泡泡的形狀跟彩虹顏色，竟是同一層皮在做兩件不同的事囉？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling warmly with an approving nod behind her oak counter.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 完全命中！這正是開頭賣的關子——從沾框吹出第一口氣到頭頂變黑，兩股力量都在這層薄皮上同時上演！

scenes.chapter: 原來同一層泡泡皮，竟藏著形狀與光的雙重秘密

data.prompt: Medium shot in the warm golden-hour courtyard with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, beaming with a huge joyful eureka smile holding up her square wire wand with a bright iridescent bubble floating beside her.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來如此！還記得開頭方框吹出的彩虹球嗎？我們看見的從來不是彩色肥皂水，而是省料力氣跟光波對撞的雙重直播！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the warm golden-hour wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling proudly behind her oak counter watching a gentle iridescent bubble drift past the sunlit window.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 說得太棒了！我覺得最迷人的是，每當你看著彩虹在泡泡身上流動，其實就是在親眼見證這層皮一點點變薄的旅程。

data.prompt: Close-up cozy golden-hour scene: a clear iridescent soap bubble hanging on a small square wire wand framed cleanly in front of a deep charcoal-navy shaded courtyard wall so its vivid final golden-white rim and dark top shine unmistakably.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 留個好玩的小觀察給你：下次把泡泡留在框上、背後找一面深色的牆，仔細看頂上變黑之前，最後留下的是什麼顏色！

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit cozy patio table: a shimmering small cluster of translucent soap bubbles resting on a wet saucer showing clear three-way junctions glowing softly in late-afternoon sunbeams.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 順便再吹出一小串黏在一起的泡泡，低頭數數看每一個牆面交叉處，是不是真的都剛好只有三片牆碰在一起！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, facing the viewer with a warm approachable smile and one open five-fingered hand, clean wooden wall behind.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 最後問問你：你吹過最大或撐最久的泡泡有多厲害？試完剛剛的觀察，也歡迎留言跟大家分享結果！

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 喜歡從童年隨手玩的泡泡裡挖出物理真相，別忘了訂閱原來如此事務所，我們下次見！
